subject: Mutual action plan: evidence routing, archival & DPA redlines
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fiducia.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@fiducia.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: evidence routing, archival & DPA redlines

Alex / Marta —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, we'll align the MAP (mutual action plan) to two parallel tracks: 1) security evidence intake and acceptance criteria (SOC 2 + SIG/CAIQ) and 2) DPA redline + data lifecycle (retention, archival, escrow). Goal is to surface the minimal acceptance checklist that unlocks your sandbox pilot and a path-to-sign for production.

Quick ask: can you confirm which of the following is highest priority for your legal/security teams this week so we can sequence work?
- SOC 2 evidence (control-owner mapping + sample artifacts)
- SIG questionnaire items you need answered verbatim (we can provide CAIQ mapping)
- DPA redlines (we already uploaded a first-pass PDF)
- Data retention / archival policy specifics (EU residency / deletion SLA)

Neha / Karthik / Jonas — internal owners: Neha will own evidence intake and timeline for SOC 2 artifacts; Karthik will do a walkthrough of our SIG/CAIQ mapping; Jonas can coordinate DPA redline logistics and DocuSign flow.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx (starter template), DPA-redlines-v1.pdf (our annotate).

Proposed milestone cadence (high level):
1) Evidence intake window opens: Jun 8–12 (partner provides initial Q/A + few artifacts)
2) SIG mapping walkthrough: Jun 10 (30 min)
3) DPA redline review + counter: Jun 12–16
4) Mutual acceptance decision (pilot enable): Jun 18

Alex / Marta — can you confirm availability for the SIG walkthrough (Jun 10 10am PT) and whether your security team needs additional identity-of-contact?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

Stephanie Nguyen
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0196

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fiducia.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@fiducia.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:24:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: evidence routing, archival & DPA redlines

Thanks Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear milestones. Quick answers from our side:
- Priority: DPA redlines first (legal has a tight window), then SOC 2 artifacts.
- SIG/CAIQ: security wants the CAIQ mapping ahead of the walkthrough so they can pre-flag three domains (network, key mgmt, logging).
- Retention: we require 7-year archival for certain records and a 30-day secure-delete SLA for PII after request; we can share a short annex with specifics.

We can make Jun 10 10am PT work for an initial SIG session — Alex + Marta will join; I'll loop in our InfoSec lead (cc'ing Marta to add).

One ask: your DPA-redlines-v1.pdf shows some default Redwood hosting language; our counsel will ask for an on-prem/private deployment carveout and clearer KMS option language. If you can have someone from your legal/priv deployments team ready that would speed review.

I'll upload the annex and a short retention table by EOD Jun 4.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Vendor Risk
Fiducia Bank
alex.rivera@fiducia.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fiducia.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@fiducia.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: evidence routing, archival & DPA redlines

Alex / Marta —

Thanks — that's helpful. To keep the intake light for your security team, we'll do two things: 1) I'll pre-populate the SOC2-evidence-inventory.xlsx with examples and a short notes column asking for either "link/attach" or "n/a", and 2) Karthik will export a one-page CAIQ summary mapping our controls to the SIG domains you flagged.

Karthik — can you produce the one-pager by EOD Jun 9 so Alex can circulate to their InfoSec ahead of the Jun 10 session?
Jonas — for the DPA carveouts (on-prem, KMS options, escrow), can you prepare a short options memo and a recommended fallback we can live-demo during pilot (e.g., dedicated VPC + BYOK)? That will help legal evaluate quickly.

I'll also set up a shared folder (private) and post the SOC2 inventory + CAIQ one-pager there by Jun 6. Link to follow.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fiducia.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: evidence routing, archival & DPA redlines

Alex / team —

Following our SIG session and a quick legal sync, attaching the CAIQ one-pager summary in the shared folder (link below) and a short options memo for DPA carveouts. Highlights:
- CAIQ one-pager: maps the 3 domains you flagged and includes sample artifact IDs that align with our SOC 2 toolkit.
- DPA options memo: recommended path = Dedicated VPC + BYOK (we outline implementation steps + estimated pilot impact). If legal insists on on-prem, we note the expected timeline delta (6–8 weeks) and the associated escalation path.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) We'll incorporate your retention annex into a draft DPA update and return a redline by Jun 19.
2) Neha will run an evidence sampling (we'll ask for 3 artifacts per domain) and present acceptance/non-acceptance criteria in-line.
3) Stephanie — can you confirm the mutual acceptance decision checkpoint for Jun 22 (we had Jun 18 earlier; pushing to allow legal review)?

Shared folder: https://drive.example.com/teams/fiducia-redwood/MAP-2026 (read-only link for your InfoSec).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Applied ML & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
